title: connectors.messages_changed v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the connectors module, in the transaction that records how far it read, when a change stream yields a MessageChangeBatch for an inbox. Ids only: the batch itself is a blob. The conversations module consumes it and enqueues `conversations.apply_changes` (ordered per inbox). Workspace-scoped.

workspace.description: The workspace id (the event bus keys deliveries by it).

inbox_id.description: The conversations inbox; equals the batch's `inbox`.

batch.description: The MessageChangeBatch v1 document, a blob of the workspace (campbooks_kernel::blobs::BlobRef).

cursor.description: The change stream's cursor after this batch (opaque, provider-specific, never personal data).
